newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB estimated wheat pool price unchanged.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB estimated wheat pool price unchanged.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board on Monday left unchanged at A$195.00 a tonne FOB its 1996/97 estimated pool price for Australian Standard White (ASW) wheat.
Estimates for higher protein Australian Hard and Prime Hard categories were also left unchanged at A$210.00 and A$225.00 a tonne FOB, respectively.

"With an anticipaed 20 million-tonne crop and the relative stability seen in international wheat prices over the past two weeks, today's pool estimates reflect the current situation in a delicately balanced market," the AWB said in a statement.
